k.q: Model the first comparison when merging the already sorted pairs [3,8] and [1,5].
k.code:
array left = [3,8]
array right = [1,5]
if left[0] < right[0] then
    print(left[0])

p: Predict the first value printed during merging.
Change right[0] to 4 and predict the new output.
On paper write the fully merged order of the original pairs.
k.a: Original first value is 1, as 1 < 3. Changing right[0] to 4 causes 3 to print. Fully merging [3,8] and [1,5] gives [1,3,5,8]. The code models one comparison, not an entire merge-sort routine.
